justification: Evidence-backed categorical gate. Castle Table 2 (PDF p8) defines alley cropping on annual cropland or forage grown between tree rows without grazing, excluding existing tree crops. WorldCover 40 maps annual cropland. WorldCover 30 is conditional on a verified managed-forage/non-grazing mask; it is not treated as pasture proof. Built-up, permanent snow/ice and permanent water cannot satisfy this host definition. Tree/shrub cover remains unknown because those classes mix farms and non-farms.

Evidence-backed categorical gate. WOCAT 507 describes restoring degraded wasteland and improving depleted farmland (Kenya example, PDF p1). Within the regeneration-on-farmland family, WorldCover alone cannot identify degradation or farmland history. Positive classes require observed depleted/degraded farmland masks; bare soil alone is never evidence of restoration potential. This gate establishes land-use compatibility, not regeneration success or rootstock presence. Tree cover remains unresolved.

WorldCover grassland requires independent grazing-system confirmation. Other vegetation classes remain unresolved because they may mix wooded pasture, natural vegetation and other systems. Supporting evidence remains held by Pete; default execution returns pending_evidence_review until that review is resolved.

Candidate applicability gate for windbreaks/shelterbelts only. Castle Table 2 PDF p8 places windbreaks on delineated cropland/pasture field boundaries in the US Midwest. WorldCover cropland requires independently mapped field-boundary placement; grassland additionally requires managed pasture confirmation. No universal buffer width or contour-siting rule is inferred. Report applicability zones and candidate line length, never eligible pixel area as planting footprint. Source and cross-context mapping remain pending review.

Candidate coffee host gate. Family-method F5 requires existing observed crop distribution. Jezeer et al. (2017), PDF p4, documents shade trees among coffee/cocoa plants; linked economic evidence supports host-system identity only, not a land-cover suitability score or threshold. WorldCover vegetation classes are permissive carriers ONLY when an independent observed coffee mask confirms the cultivated crop. Forest cover alone never passes. MapSPAM allocation is not observed presence. Presence does not establish a shade deficit or benefit; map target crop area, not full mixed-pixel area. Crosswalk and source evidence remain pending review.
